subject: DI01000191

intro_text.en: Bilingual teaching notes with construction, working, applications and revision. Exam has questions only. Use supervised models; no actual practical is claimed.
intro_text.gu: English technical keywords સાથે સરળ ગુજરાતી સમજ. Construction, working, applications અને revision. Exam માં માત્ર પ્રશ્નો. Supervised model વાપરો; actual practical નો દાવો નથી.

body.en:
A coupling joins shafts to transmit torque under its designed alignment conditions, usually without routine engagement/disengagement while operating. A clutch provides controlled connection/disconnection of drive. A brake retards, stops or holds motion by applying a resisting action.

A friction clutch and brake can both dissipate heat, but their functional roles differ. A coupling is not automatically a safety brake; do not use one as a suspended-load holding device.
body.gu:
Coupling designed alignment માં shafts જોડીને torque આપે; સામાન્ય routine running engagement/disengagement માટે નહીં. Clutch drive જોડે/અલગ કરે. Brake motion ધીમું, stop અથવા hold કરે.

Friction clutch/brake heat dissipate કરી શકે, પણ functions જુદા. Coupling suspended load ની safety brake નથી.

body.en:
A box or sleeve coupling encloses/co-joins aligned shaft ends through an appropriate sleeve/key/fastening arrangement. It is a rigid coupling example for suitably aligned shafts.

A flange coupling uses flanges secured to shaft ends and joined with designed bolts. Torque travels through the engineered hub/key/bolt/contact arrangement. Rigid couplings do not compensate arbitrary misalignment; poor alignment loads bearings and joints.
body.gu:
Box/sleeve coupling sleeve/key/fastening વડે aligned shaft ends જોડે; rigid example છે.

Flange coupling shaft flanges ને designed bolts વડે જોડે. Torque hub/key/bolt/contact design પ્રમાણે જાય. Rigid coupling arbitrary misalignment સુધારતું નથી; ખોટું alignment bearings પર load આપે.

body.en:
A pin/bush flexible coupling uses pins with compliant bushes/elements between suitable hubs/flanges. It transmits torque while accommodating limited specified misalignment and cushioning some shock/vibration.

The flexible element has load, speed, temperature and wear limits. It is not permission to ignore alignment or use broken bushes. Suitable application: a motor-to-driven-machine connection within manufacturer limits.
body.gu:
Pins અને compliant bushes/elements hubs/flanges વચ્ચે હોય છે. Torque transmit સાથે મર્યાદિત specified misalignment અને થોડું shock/vibration accommodate કરે.

Load/speed/T/wear limits છે; broken bush અથવા alignment અવગણવાની permission નહીં. Motor-driven machine connection માં suitable limits મુજબ ઉપયોગ.

body.en:
A universal joint connects shafts at a designed angle through yokes and a cross/appropriate joint mechanism. It permits angular motion while transmitting torque in its operating geometry.

A single conventional Hooke/Cardan joint at an angle generally produces cyclic output-speed variation even at constant input speed. Proper multiple-joint/CV designs can address this under specific arrangements. Applications include suitable vehicle/driveline and machinery joints; not unlimited angle or arbitrary offset.
body.gu:
Yokes અને cross/joint mechanism વડે designed angle પર shafts torque આપે.

Single conventional Hooke/Cardan joint angle પર હોય તો constant input છતાં output speed cyclic vary થઈ શકે. Proper multiple-joint/CV arrangements માં સુધારો થાય. Vehicle/driveline/machinery માટે, unlimited angle/offset માટે નહીં.

body.en:
An Oldham coupling commonly has two hubs with slots and an intermediate disc with tongues on opposite faces oriented at right angles. Sliding engagement accommodates a specified parallel offset between shaft axes while transmitting rotation.

Distinguish parallel offset from the angular shaft relationship highlighted for a universal joint. Sliding contact needs suitable material/lubrication and wear assessment; misalignment capacity is finite.
body.gu:
બે slotted hubs અને intermediate disc પર opposite faces ની tongues right angle માં હોય. Sliding engagement torque સાથે specified parallel shaft offset accommodate કરે.

Universal joint ના angular relation થી parallel offset જુદો છે. Sliding wear/material/lubrication અને finite capacity ધ્યાનમાં લો.

body.en:
A disc clutch uses friction surfaces clamped between suitable driving/driven members, often a flywheel/pressure plate and a lined driven disc. Springs or another actuator provide clamping; a release mechanism reduces it to disengage.

Engaged contact transmits torque; during engagement slip can convert mechanical energy to heat. After full engagement the intended condition is little/no relative slip within capacity. Applications include suitable vehicle and machine drives. Overload/slipping can overheat linings; do not touch or adjust running parts.
body.gu:
Disc clutch માં lined disc, driving/driven friction surfaces, pressure plate અને clamping/release mechanism હોય.

Engage થાય ત્યારે friction torque આપે; engagement slip માં heat થાય. Fully engage પર capacity અંદર relative slip ઓછું/નહીં રહેવું intended છે. Vehicle/machine drives માટે. Overload/slip થી lining overheat; running adjustment નહીં.

body.en:
Rotating weights/shoes move outward as speed-related centrifugal effects exceed the opposing spring arrangement. They contact a drum and transmit torque by friction; at sufficiently low speed the springs withdraw them under the design.

Applications include suitable small-engine drives. Engagement speed and load capacity depend on mass, spring and geometry. This is automatic speed-dependent engagement, not an automatic guarantee against overload or a safety stop.
body.gu:
Rotating weights/shoes speed વધતાં spring opposition સામે બહાર ખસે અને drum contact થી friction torque આપે. Low speed પર design મુજબ springs પાછાં ખેંચે.

Suitable small-engine drives માં ઉપયોગ. Engagement speed mass/spring/geometry પર આધારિત. Automatic engagement એટલે overload protection અથવા safety stop guarantee નહીં.

body.en:
A block brake presses a friction block/shoe against a rotating drum/wheel in a suitable arrangement. Shoe brake is broader terminology; internal expanding drum brakes press curved shoes against the inside of a drum, while external shoes contact the outside.

Friction resists motion and produces heat. Normal force, contact geometry, lining and cooling affect performance. A hand diagram does not define a safe stopping distance or load-holding capacity.
body.gu:
Block brake suitable drum/wheel પર friction block/shoe દબાવે. Shoe brake broader term છે; internal expanding માં curved shoes drum અંદર contact અને external માં બહાર contact કરે.

Friction motion resist કરીને heat બનાવે. Normal force/geometry/lining/cooling મહત્વના. Diagram થી safe stopping distance/load capacity ન નક્કી થાય.

body.en:
A flexible lined band wraps around part of a drum. Applied tension causes frictional contact, giving a resisting torque; tight/slack-side tension and wrap geometry influence behaviour.

Suitable machinery applications depend on the engineered actuation and holding design. Direction-dependent effects can occur. A band brake must not be assumed safe for lifting duties without rated, fail-safe system protection.
body.gu:
Flexible lined band drum નો ભાગ wrap કરે. Tension થી friction resisting torque આપે; tight/slack tension અને wrap geometry effect કરે.

Engineered actuation/holding પ્રમાણે machinery માં. Direction-dependent behaviour હોઈ શકે. Rated fail-safe protection વગર lifting માટે safe assume નહીં.

body.en:
A rotor/disc rotates with the shaft or wheel. Pads in a caliper are pressed against the disc by a mechanical/hydraulic/pneumatic arrangement as designed. Friction produces braking torque and heat; cooling and friction condition affect fade and performance.

Applications include vehicles and selected machinery. Never contaminate friction surfaces with lubricant, work under unsupported vehicles or touch hot discs. Maintenance, fluid handling and wear limits require the exact approved service procedure.
body.gu:
Rotor/disc shaft/wheel સાથે ફરે. Caliper pads designed actuator થી disc પર દબાય; friction torque અને heat બને. Cooling/friction condition થી fade/performance બદલાય.

Vehicles/machinery માટે. Friction surface પર oil નહીં; unsupported vehicle નીચે કામ નહીં; hot disc ને touch નહીં. Exact service procedure જરૂરી.

body.en:
Identify each device by its energy/torque path: rigid/flexible shaft connection, controllable drive engagement or resisting action. Match alignment, speed, torque, duty, heat and safety rating.

Use isolated models for assembly/dismantling. Springs, hydraulic pressure and rotating inertia can store energy even after the motor stops. Guard, isolate and verify safe condition through the authorised procedure; no real assembly is claimed.
body.gu:
Energy/torque path પરથી ઓળખો: shaft connection, controlled engagement કે resisting action. Alignment/speed/torque/duty/heat/safety rating match કરો.

Isolated models જ. Motor બંધ પછી પણ springs/hydraulics/inertia energy રાખી શકે. Authorised isolation/verification કરો; actual assembly નો દાવો નથી.

a.en: No, at angle it can vary cyclically.

items.f: Coupling joins; clutch engages; brake resists

q.en: Practice: Distinguish coupling, clutch and brake.
Practice: Compare Universal and Oldham mechanisms.
Practice: Explain block/shoe, band and disc brakes.
Practice: State applications and stored-energy safety.
